summary:
# Analytic normal sweep centroid and moments

The isolated commit is `879b2fe0b5539bb5f6fbc4d675937c175e3a0403` on `d9ebf716`. The portable patch SHA-256 is `270e4f6d71aa4c8c3c385bc398cb161f13adc7190358d64374890625b497b2b5`. Four new files add the query and tests. The original volume implementation remains byte-identical.

`VerifiedNormalOffsetSweep.MassMomentsRational` computes material moments at unit density. It encloses volume, world first moments, world second moment tensor, centroid and both world-origin and centroidal inertia tensors. A complete result meets explicit positive interval widths for volume, centroid, second moments and inertia. First moments are enclosed alongside those quantities. Subdivision depth, visited cells, exact operations and coefficient bits bound the work. A resource refusal preserves the last valid numerical enclosure when available and may leave it wider than requested. Cancellation clears numerical bounds. Every published numerical enclosure has a strictly positive proved volume lower bound.

The proof uses the original immutable full-sweep injectivity and determinant sign certificate. On a UV cell, its analytic sweep map is affine in signed displacement and its determinant is quadratic. Directed original source position, normal and differential intervals enclose the coefficients. Integrating signed displacement powers through degree four gives volume and all first and second moment contributions. Directed dyadic UV accumulation preserves the strongest certified bounds and controls denominator growth. The centered reference is the exact Cartesian hull midpoint of original homogeneous controls, which reduces translation cancellation during the centroid and centered tensor calculations. The physical material determinant applies the exact full-sweep sign, including a verified sweep strictly beyond its focal layer. A verified constant-weight affine net uses exact uniform parallelepiped formulas. Rational unit normals give exact point intervals in that case.

Both an axis-aligned slab and an independently authored translated 3-4-5 rational rotation produce exact centroid and every tensor entry, with volume `26/7`, one visited cell and 724 exact operations under a 64-bit coefficient bound. The ordinary parabolic strip completes in 919 cells and 1,375,901 operations. The independent source integration gives volume approximately 0.07453980153375 and centroid approximately `[0,0.5,0.04221034079]`. A rotated native negative-Jacobian strip completes in 471 cells and 705,362 operations, with independent volume approximately 0.003108754885267 and centroid `[-0.5,0,0.7531827934]`. The exact rational stereographic spherical sector completes in 25 cells and 39,288 operations. Its independent radial and angular integration gives volume approximately 0.007395969562419 and axial centroid about 1.380757345. Exact alternating rational angular sums provide an additional independent enclosure of the sphere's axial second moment, using the fourth radial power.

The tests check every raw and derived entry on the independent curved integrals, coarse positive fallback under a cell limit, early numerical refusal with insufficient exact work, exact one-short work exhaustion, cancellation and independent ownership of returned rational bounds. Both historical positive and negative `VolumeRational` full JSON receipts match their baseline bytes, including exact work counters. The result is scoped to one original verified single-span normal sweep. All source integration is independent of triangulation.

The final focused race and package logs are in this directory alongside the two historical receipt comparisons.
